cohort: The study included 5,796 reproductive-age women in Ethiopia.
finding: Home delivery in Ethiopia exhibited a non-random spatial distribution with significant hotspots in several regions, and was significantly associated with lower maternal education, poor wealth, high community poverty, rural residence, certain marital statuses, and older maternal ages.
mod_finding: Factors significantly increasing the odds of home delivery included lower levels of education, poor wealth, living in rural areas, high community-level poverty, divorced/separated/widowed marital status, and older maternal ages.
